nodes.label: Farm Owner (Actor)
nodes.rationale: Top-level tenant/ownership actor. Owns farms and consumes cross-farm reporting; does not perform day-to-day operational data entry, which is delegated to Farm Manager and Farm Worker.

nodes.label: Manage Farms (UC04)
nodes.source_location: UML use case diagram, single page
nodes.rationale: Farm is the root aggregate of the tenancy hierarchy (Farm -> Pen -> Batch), so only the Farm Owner may create or modify it.

nodes.label: Authenticate (Shared Included Use Case)
nodes.rationale: Factored out as a single «include» target reused by every use case in the system rather than duplicated per flow; this makes authentication a non-optional cross-cutting precondition and keeps each use case diagram focused on its own business logic.
